# 小兔头节拍器 / Bunny Metronome

> A free browser metronome for piano, drums, dance practice, and running cadence. Bilingual, no install, no account, no telemetry.

## About

A web-only metronome with three sound modes and six time signatures. Open the URL in any browser and it just works — desktop, mobile, iOS, Android.

Features:
- BPM range 40–208
- 6 time signatures: 4/4, 3/4, 2/4, 6/8, 5/4, 7/8
- 3 sound modes: classic drum (strong/weak beats), uniform click, child-voice counting (Web Speech Synthesis)
- Bilingual UI (中文 / English)
- iOS silent-mode heuristic — warns once if the ringer is off
- Static HTML — no backend, no auth, no tracking

Intended for:
- Piano / guitar / drum practice
- Dance rehearsal across time signatures
- Running cadence training
- Music teaching (the voice mode helps young students keep count)
